Geographies Served Programs Project #01 - Educational Scholarships for Govt School & Home Children College Education – Education For All District Bangalore Tiruvallur Cuddalore Vellore Perambalur Tiruchirappalli Tiruvannamalai Coimbatore Mumbai Chennai Kanchipuram Ranipet State Karnataka Tamil Nadu Maharashtra District Bangalore Tiruvallur Cuddalore Vellore Perambalur Tiruchirappalli Tiruvannamalai Coimbatore Mumbai Chennai Kanchipuram Ranipet States Karnataka Tamil Nadu Maharashtra Dream India works with close to about 13 govt schools and various homes in Tamil Nadu. We also have our study center in Bangalore and Mumbai. We have received educational scholarship requests from the children of these government schools for higher education and also children of our study center for school education. These government schools are in Chennai, Kancheepuram, Tiruvannamalai, Cuddalore and other parts of TN. We also work with various homes like Udhavum Nanbargal, Payir, SV home and Vasantham were the children need educational assistance. Project #03 – Project Thiramai Thiruvizha – Talent Festival District Tiruvallur Perambalur Tiruvannamalai Chennai Kanchipuram Ranipet State Tamil Nadu District Tiruvallur Perambalur Tiruvannamalai Chennai Kanchipuram Ranipet States Tamil Nadu Dream India team visits one rural school every month and conduct elocution, Essay, drawing, Thirukural, Quiz and cultural events for all the children. Volunteers interested in serving rural government school children are welcome to participate and motivate the children. These events typically costs about 40,000 INR to 50,000 INR which includes lunch, snacks and prizes for all the children (usually 200 plus). Yearly Event – Annual Meet at Chennai for all TN based schools and homes 30 children from each of these school participate in a yearly event at Chennai where about 10 to 12 school children participate. This event takes about 40,000 INR for each school. They visit metro, anna library, Birla planetarium, corporate office to learn how people work, Vivekananda house, beach and then leave back. We also get wish list items from the children and gift them. These trips costs about 50,000 INR which includes transport, food and all expenses related to children. the day we met Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam sir in Jaipur during his visit in 2002 - we started our work for Dream India. Today, more than 2000 children got graduated and contributes back to Dream India in the form volunteering for various dream India programs, weekly classes, sponsoring other children for education, running study centers, conducting thiramai thiruvizha etc. Every year we reach out to 5000 plus rural children spread across 13 different rural parts of Tamil Nadu. We truly believe each of us can make DREAM INDIA possible for the local community we work with. This can be done without any compromise to our professional life, family life or any such give away. Vision and Mission Dream India envisions a developed India free of poverty and illiteracy, with a mission to mobilize the energy and spirit of India's youth to better the lives of underprivileged children through education and other activities.
